name: necx-outreach
description: Plan NECX multi-thread outreach to victim-services organizations (research, contact ranking, To/CC/BCC, emails) and render personalized faceless videos on real VS360 screens that show the prospect's agency and name.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Voice for personalized outreach videos (elevenlabs.io → Profile → API keys). Stored in your system keychain. Leave empty to use the macOS voice, which is for review only.

elevenlabs_voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID (optional)
elevenlabs_voice_id.description: Voice used for narration. Empty = Sarah (EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL), the voice used in NECX's product videos.

sender_name.title: Your name (video sign-off)
sender_name.description: Shown on each video's title card and call to action, e.g. Jordan Avery.

sender_title.title: Your title
sender_title.description: Shown next to your name on the call to action, e.g. Partnerships, NECX.

sender_email.title: Your NECX email
sender_email.description: Shown on the call to action, e.g. jordan@necx.org.
